## 更新内容 / Changes

- 新建 ChatGPT 账号实例优先使用原生登录，接入方式和能力差异直接显示。已有实例和复制实例保留所选模式，切换接入方式保留账号及模型选择；需要管理器代理的账号继续使用本地 API。
- 修复原生 OAuth 凭据遗漏刷新时间、导致当前客户端无法识别 ChatGPT 登录的问题。保留客户端续期时间，兼容没有时间记录的旧账号；有效访问令牌不再仅因缓存身份令牌过期而反复刷新。
- 兼容新版 ChatGPT 桌面应用中的 Codex 内置程序路径，恢复 CLI 发现与官方会话工具的识别。
- 会话可见性修复默认按各实例下次启动的连接匹配，避免停止后还原的配置误导修复目标。修改前重新检查运行状态和配置，并保留预览与备份。
- New ChatGPT account instances prefer native sign-in and show the connection mode and feature differences directly. Existing and copied instances retain their selected mode; mode changes preserve the account and model. Accounts requiring the manager's upstream proxy continue using Local API.
- Fixed missing OAuth refresh metadata that prevented current clients from recognizing ChatGPT sign-in. Client refresh timestamps are retained, legacy accounts remain supported, and a healthy access token no longer rotates solely because cached identity metadata expired.
- Recognizes the bundled Codex executable in current ChatGPT desktop applications for CLI discovery and official session tools.
- Session visibility repair defaults to each instance's next launch connection instead of its restored dormant configuration, and rechecks running state and configuration before writing. Preview and backups remain available.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP，附件包含 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。请先完成运行中的任务并让管理器彻底退出，再安装新版；账号、实例与本地配置保留。已有本地 API 实例需停止后在编辑中选择「原生账号登录」，不会自动切换运行中的实例。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。

DMG and ZIP packages are available for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Finish active work and exit the manager completely before installing; accounts, instances and local settings are retained. To use native sign-in for an existing Local API instance, stop it and change its mode in the editor. Running instances are never switched automatically. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included.

## 客户端支持 / Client support

当前支持 Codex，客户端需单独安装。Claude Code 与 Claude Desktop（Chat / Cowork / Code）为计划功能，尚未接入。原生模式使用独立文件凭据；原生代理与 API 密钥绑定独立 OAuth 身份尚未接入。桌面菜单和语言适配取决于 Codex 版本，Fast 还取决于模型和服务商能力。

Codex is currently supported and must be installed separately. Claude Code and Claude Desktop (Chat / Cowork / Code) are planned, not implemented. Native mode uses isolated file credentials; native proxy projection and API keys paired with a separate OAuth identity are not implemented. Desktop menu and language integration depend on the Codex version; Fast also depends on the model and provider.

## 来源与校验 / Source and verification

版本来源可通过本 Release 的 `v0.4.9` 标签与提交链接核实；构建验证见仓库的 Build release 工作流。下载同一 Release 的 `SHA256SUMS.txt` 后执行 `shasum -a 256 --check SHA256SUMS.txt` 验证安装包。

Verify the source using this Release's `v0.4.9` tag and commit links, and its Build release workflow. Download `SHA256SUMS.txt` from the same Release and run `shasum -a 256 --check SHA256SUMS.txt` to verify the installers.
